items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I can't tell you that, because I don't know. I've known him ever since, but I don't know.

ctx.x: Well, how did Joe Sullivan come up? Out of nowhere?
I can't tell you that, because I don't know. I've known him ever since, but I don't know.
There are several pianists around Chicago. And you're right. None of them were remarkable, except Joe.
